title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics SLO context enrichment + slo-toolkit helpers
author: Maya Chen
commits_summary: 3 commits: add SLO context enricher and utility functions; wire enricher into incident-bot diagnostics pipeline; add unit tests and documentation; bump chart values for new config flags
body: Motivation: On several recent incidents the oncall flow lacked easy access to SLO context (error budget burn, SLO owner, recent regressions) which slowed diagnostics. This PR enriches incident-bot diagnostics payloads with SLO context provided by slo-toolkit utilities and exposes on-call helper endpoints so runbooks can show actionable SLO links. What changed: 1) New slo-toolkit context_utils that fetches and formats SLO metadata from the SLO service and caches results. 2) New incident-bot diagnositcs enricher (slo_context_enricher.py) that attaches SLO summary, owner, recent alert snippets, and runbook links to the diagnostics envelope. 3) Oncall helper endpoints to surface quick links (jump to SLO dashboard, open rollback playbook) in the UI and slack messages. 4) Unit tests for the utilities and integration test covering the diagnostics pipeline. 5) Docs: updated runbook and oncall diagnostics guide. Backwards compatibility and rollout: The enricher is behind a feature flag (incidentBot.enableSLOEnrichment) defaulting to off; rollout plan is staged enabling for internal teams then everyone after telemetry looks stable. The enricher gracefully degrades if the SLO service is unreachable (adds a note in diagnostics and continues). Testing and CI: Added unit tests and a lightweight integration test; CI matrix includes lint, unit, integration; initial CI run failed on lint (unused import) and a flaky test which were fixed in subsequent commits. Monitoring: Added metrics incident_bot.slo_enricher.success and incident_bot.slo_enricher.latency and a tracing span for the enrichment step. Documentation: docs/runbooks/oncall-diagnostics.md contains examples and how to interpret the added SLO fields. Security and perf: calls to SLO service use service account with scoped read-only permissions and a 500ms timeout; results are cached for 30s to limit qps. Related: ENG-1457 (oncall improvements), ENG-1483 (slo-toolkit churn reduction). Merge: squash merge after approvals and green CI. Release notes: Adds optional SLO context enrichment for incident diagnostics and new oncall quick-links.
review_comments: Arjun Patel: Nice approach. Can you add a higher-level test that asserts diagnostics JSON contains expected SLO fields when feature flag is enabled?

Riley Thompson: Two nits: prefer 30s cache to be configurable via chart values and please add metrics for cache hits/misses.
Maya Chen: Made cache ttl configurable (charts/incident-bot/values.yaml) and added incident_bot.slo_enricher.cache_hits/misses metrics.
Samir Gupta: Approving pending CI green. Verified feature flag gating and that failure to reach SLO service is non-fatal.
